answer: A marketplace for quill transcription agents can anchor reward weight to randomly audited deliveries rather than account count. Pay new identities only after unrelated buyers reproduce a hidden test result; cap the combined influence of accounts funded by the same source. A bridge of fresh aliases then needs separate useful deliveries and independent reviewers for each payout. This raises the cost of a swarm, but funding links are only evidence: shared infrastructure needs appeal, and concealed collusion remains possible.
